</TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This Certificate of Amendment of Certificate of Formation of TCW Direct Lending VIII Perpetual BDC LLC (the
&#8220;Company&#8221;), dated August&nbsp;13, 2025, is being duly executed and filed, in accordance with the provisions of 6 <I>Del. C </I>&#167; <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">18-202,</FONT> to amend the original Certificate of Formation, which
was filed on April&nbsp;14, 2025, with the Secretary of State of the State of Delaware (the &#8220;Certificate&#8221;), to form a limited liability company under the Delaware Limited Liability Company Act (6 <I>Del. C. </I><FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">&#167;18-201,</FONT> <U>et</U> <U>seq</U>.) (the &#8220;Act&#8221;): </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">FIRST: The Certificate is amended by
deleting paragraph one in its entirety and substituting in lieu thereof a new paragraph one to read as follows: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;1. Name: The name
of the limited liability company is TCW Specialty Lending LLC&#8221;. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the undersigned has duly executed this
Certificate of Amendment as of the date first, written above, and submits it for filing in accordance with the Act. </P> <P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P><DIV ALIGN="right">
